sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Smt. Justice G.Anupama Chakravarthy
 Writ Petition No.19360 Of 2023
Order:

This Writ Petition is filed seeking a writ of mandamus declaring the action of the respondents registering F.I.R.No.163/2023 dated 03.07.2023 basing on the complaint dated 03.07.2023 filed by respondent No.4 on the file of Chinnakodur Police Station for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 324, 498A of I.P.C. and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and further pressurizing the petitioners to compromise with the complainant and threatening them to arrest and remand to judicial custody as illegal and arbitrary and consequently to quash the proceedings in F.I.R.No.163 of 2023 dated 03.07.2023.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home for the respondent Nos.1 to 3.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners contended that the basing on the report of respondent No.4, a case was 2 GAC,J W.P.NO.19360 OF 2023 registered against the petitioner Nos.1 to 7 herein and further, respondent No.3 was threatening to arrest and remand the petitioners.

Though the writ petition is filed challenging the FIR, learned counsel for the petitioners restricts his prayer to the extent that a direction be issued to the Station House Officer, Chinnakodur Police Station, to issue notice under Section 41-A Cr.P.C. to the petitioner.

4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home representing respondent Nos.1 to 3 also contended that all the offences alleged against the petitioners are punishable with less than seven years imprisonment.
5. As seen from the material on record, the petitioners are being prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 324 and 498A of I.P.C. and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

The sentence of imprisonment prescribed for the aforesaid offences is below seven (7) years.
6.

Under these circumstances, the petitioners are directed to appear before the Investigating Officer on 28.07.2023 and on their appearance, the Investigating 3 GAC,J W.P.NO.19360 OF 2023 Officer shall issue notice under Section 41-A Cr.P.C. to the petitioners and strictly adhere to the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar and another1.

7. With the above direction, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous applications, if any, pending shall stand closed.
